title: One-piece phone stand (side profile)
prompt: One-piece phone stand: a side profile extruded 70 mm wide. From the front: a 6 mm wide lip 16 mm tall, then a 10 mm wide slot for the phone's edge, then the back rest. The base is 90 mm deep and 6 mm thick. The back rest's front face runs in a straight line from the back of the slot (16 mm from the front, on top of the base) up to 42 mm from the front at 66 mm height; the top is flat and 8 mm deep, and the back slopes straight down to the rear edge of the base at 6 mm height.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
90 mm deep, 66 mm tall, 70 mm wide, ±0.3 mm
Eleven flat faces: nine profile edges plus the two sides

notes: Profile area: base 540 + back rest 2460 + lip 60 = 3060 mm².
